title: Exploring Transformer Based Models to Identify Hate Speech and Offensive Content in English and Indo-Aryan Languages
reasoning: The paper focuses on an NLP classification task for identifying hate speech and offensive content. While the 'Profane' (PRFN) category is defined by a lack of respect for religious beliefs, the paper's primary objective is technical model performance evaluation on a shared task rather than evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as systems of thought or behavior.
